name: Release
owner: CAPITAL-AI-OPS / PVC-06 Version Management / PVC-07 Release Management
description: Controlled CAPITAL-AI release lifecycle, single platform-version authority, deterministic ADR-0105 scoped-branch materialization, fail-closed read-only projection services and the versioned-unit inventory projection. package.json#version is authoritative for the platform; final Git tags remain prohibited until production acceptance.

events.note: The version gate and versioned-unit inventory do not emit synthetic release events. EventMesh publication may be added only when a real accepted release state transition is persisted.

note: scripts/automation/releaseVersion.ts remains dry-run by default and requires explicit --apply. In deterministic mode it accepts --decision-evidence, refuses free --target/--classification input, validates the accepted ADR-0105 Rule Contract plus decision rule/ref/base/head identity and protected DENY boundaries, and delegates the evidence-derived target/classification into the existing release-version-gate/1.1.0 path. NONE, NO_CHANGE_ALREADY_APPLIED and materialization.eligible=false perform no mutation. The versioned-unit inventory is independently read-only: it consumes existing component manifests where present, otherwise projects the platform authority with exact Git provenance, and never mutates platform/component versions or creates a second registry. Apply keeps the existing authority/projection rollback set, hygiene/governance/build/predeploy gates and rollback-on-failure behavior; release-candidate evidence is written only after those gates pass and no final Git tag is created. Legacy VersionManager mutation/state/document-generation semantics remain suspended under ADR-0096.
